weighting: combined = 3*US + UK + 0.6*Albums + 2.4x Grammy prestige (US/UK era-normalized to 40/chart-yr; album_raw = Total EAS millions; prestige = Big Four wins*3 + noms, split among co-credits; Album/Record of the Year x1.5, Song x1.0, Best New Artist x0.7)
scoring: per single raw=(11-peak)*sqrt(weeks); era-normalized to 100 pts/chart-year; collab score split equally among credited artists
